using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    auto getroot = [&](vector<int>& parent, int u) {
        while(parent[u] != u) {
            parent[u] = parent[parent[u]];
            u = parent[u];
        }
        return u;
    };

    auto merge = [&](vector<int>& parent, vector<int>& size, int u, int v) {
        u = getroot(parent, u);
        v = getroot(parent, v);
        if(u != v) {
            size[u] += size[v];
            parent[v] = u;
        }
    };

    auto isok = [&](long long a, long long b, long long p) {
        long long res = 1;
        while(b > 0) {
            if(b & 1) res = res * a % p;
            a = a * a % p;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res == 1 ? p : 1;
    };

    auto binpow = [&](long long a, long long b) {
        long long res = 1;
        while(b > 0) {
            if(b & 1) res = res * a % 1000000007;
            a = a * a % 1000000007;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    };

    if(k == 0) {
        cout << binpow(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> parent(p), size(p,1);
    for(int i=0; i<p; ++i) parent[i]=i;

    for(int i=0; i<p; ++i) {
        int v = (long long)k * i % p;
        merge(parent, size, v, i);
    }

    long long answer = 1;
    for(int i=0; i<p; ++i) {
        if(getroot(parent, i) == i) {
            answer = (answer * (long long)isok(k, size[i], p)) % 1000000007;
        }
    }

    cout << answer;
    return 0;
}
